name: Moondust Ventures
aliases: Moondust Ventures Digital Transformation Fund SCSp
decision_note: Prague early-stage healthcare VC (Moondust founders with FONS JK Group/STAPRO, Luxembourg fund vehicle with its own AIFM GP) that invested EUR 2.6m in Somareality (Dec 2024), joined QurieGen's pre-seed (Apr 2025) and Somareality's Series A (Jun 2026); Czech portfolio company Aireen.

evidence.quote: Specializing in technology, innovation, and disruptive solutions with a focus on healthcare, we provide early-stage capital, strategic expertise, and hands-on support to help startups launch their mission, scale and thrive.
We invest in companies harnessing technology to enhance healthcare delivery, optimize patient outcomes, and expand access to quality care around the world.
We support companies pioneering innovative therapeutics and advanced diagnostic solutions.

Český fond zaměřený na investice do startupů v oblasti digitální medicíny Moondust Ventures (ředitel Marios Nicolettis na fotce) oznámil, že do startupu investuje 2,6 milionu eur, v přepočtu 65 milionů korun.
Konkrétně jde o české fondy Tensor Ventures, Lighthouse Ventures, Moondust Ventures, 22 Hor Invest a také zahraniční BSV Ventures.
The company has just raised over €3 million in an oversubscribed Series A round led by Catalyst Romania, with participation from MT-Lab, RDY Ventures, Moondust Ventures, and Gateway Ventures.

analyst_notes: Structure: Moondust Ventures s.r.o. (IČO 26209128, Pod Krejcárkem, Praha 3 - the address on the website) is owned by founders Marios Nicolettis and Zdeněk Mojžíšek together with FONS JK Group, a.s. (owner of STAPRO), per ARES; FONS JK and Moondust signed a co-investment agreement in June 2024 with a plan to set up and manage a dedicated healthcare fund (CzechCrunch 2024-06-20). The site's SFDR page names Moondust Ventures GP S.à r.l. as AIFM of Moondust Ventures Digital Transformation Fund SCSp; GLEIF lists the GP (RCS B298585, LEI registered 2026-05-12); no LEI was found for the SCSp, and no fund size, close or launch date was found in the sources reviewed (web search budget exhausted before a final check), so capital is not_disclosed and funds is empty. Typed vc (investment committee, managed fund vehicle) rather than private_investor; earlier deals were co-investments of the partners' and FONS JK's capital. Scope: Prague office; Czech portfolio company Aireen (portfolio page: location Czech Republic, invested 2025 - year only, so not used as an activity date). Sector: healthcare (digital health, biotechnology, medical devices) per About page; the site also mentions AI, cybersecurity and deep tech with healthcare applications (C12 quantum is an older exit-labelled holding). Stage derived: site says early-stage capital; observed rounds pre-seed (QurieGen) and Series A (Somareality 2026); seed included as part of 'early-stage'. Ticket not stated; the EUR 2.6m Somareality investment (Dec 2024) is the only disclosed own amount. Somareality: portfolio page says first invested 2019, so the Dec 2024 EUR 2.6m is a follow-on; Series A 'over EUR 3m' (recorded 3000000) led by Catalyst Romania per Moondust's own news post dated June 18, 2026 (class B; no independent source checked). QurieGen: EUR 2.2m pre-seed led by Tensor Ventures (amount in the preceding sentence of the article); the portfolio page says invested 2024, the round was announced 2025-04-09.
